text:
Aisha Khan: Spike update: designing tenant-scoped unwrap flow for extended SIEM retention. Goal: default 30d, exceptions to 365d with legal approval.
Tom Reyes: Sounds good. Key constraints? fewer long-lived CMKs, audited unwraps only.
Nora Chen: Proposed: tenant DEKs wrapped by per-tenant KEK; KEKs wrapped by a master HSM key. KEKs marked non-rotatable while extension active.
Aisha Khan: Approval flow: Console request -> security review -> legal signoff -> approval-service emits short-lived signed JWT.
Tom Reyes: KMS-proxy will accept signed JWT and issue one-hour unwrap token. No dev role can call proxy directly.
Nora Chen: Rego snippet we plan to use: allow_unwrap if ticket approved && actor in archive-unwrapper role.
sec-bot: Policy PR opened by @Tom Reyes: https://git.example/repo/policy/pull/123 :gear:
legal-team: We'll require justification, retention end date, custodian contact. Also quarterly re-review for >180d.
Aisha Khan: RBAC changes: add archive-unwrapper (timeboxed), log-export-reader (30d limit), remove list-objects from dev-general.
Tom Reyes: Audit requirement: every unwrap must log {actor,ticket,key_version,nonce,timestamp} to immutable audit stream. Emit SIEM event.
Nora Chen: Replay svc: read-replay account can rehydrate into sandbox SIEM when provided unwrap token. Rate-limit unwraps per-tenant.
Aisha Khan: Test plan: 1) approved ticket -> unwrap success -> audit event; 2) dev token -> 403; 3) expired JWT -> 401; 4) rate-limit enforcement.
Tom Reyes: Rollout: feature flag alpha -> staged manual approvals -> GA with console UX.
sec-bot: Task created #SEC-900 (tenant unwrap design) and pinged @legal-team :white_check_mark:
Aisha Khan: Assignments: Nora -> KMS proxy + rate limits, Tom -> RBAC + PRs, Aisha -> approval-service + UI, legal-team -> approval checklist.
Tom Reyes: I'll merge RBAC PR after legal confirms required fields.
Nora Chen: Add alerting: unwrap-fail-rate and unwrap-latency; critical if failures spike.
Aisha Khan: Thanks all. Post follow-ups or edge cases here and I'll compile design doc. :thumbsup:
